local p = {}

-- Buffs and effects (passives, buffs, debuffs) for Template:BuffLink: a small icon with the name, and the
-- card that opens on hover. Data: Module:Data/Buffs/... (sync_wiki_data.py).
local IconName = require('Module:IconName')
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')
local Consumable = require('Module:Consumable')

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

local function pic(icon, size)
	local f = IconName.iconFile(icon)
	if f == '' then return '' end
	return '[[File:' .. f .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=]]'
end

-- what the card calls the effect
local KINDS = { debuff = 'Debuff' }   -- everything else is shown as Buff, like the game

-- {{#invoke:Buff|link|id=536}}: the icon (32px) and the name; nothing when the buff is not stored
function p.link(frame)
	local d = Store.get('Buffs', frame.args.id)
	if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return '' end
	-- a debuff (harmful effect) gets its own colour for the name
	local bad = trim(d.kind) == 'debuff'
	local size = tonumber(frame.args.size) or 22   -- 22px fits in a line of text
	return '<span class="aa-bufftip-ico' .. (bad and ' aa-bufftip-bad' or '') .. '" style="width:' .. size .. 'px;height:' .. size .. 'px;">' .. pic(d.icon, size) .. '</span><span class="aa-bufftip-name' .. (bad and ' aa-bufftip-debuff' or '') .. '">' .. esc(d.name) .. '</span>'
end

-- {{#invoke:Buff|card|id=536}}: the box with icon, kind, name and the text of the game
function p.card(frame)
	local d = Store.get('Buffs', frame.args.id)
	if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return '' end
	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-buff')
	local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-buff-head')
	head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-buff-icon'):wikitext(pic(d.icon, 48))
	local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-buff-title')
	title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-buff-kind'):wikitext(KINDS[trim(d.kind)] or 'Buff')
	title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-buff-name'):wikitext(esc(d.name))
	local text = Consumable.paragraphs(d.desc, 'aa-buff-text')
	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-buff-sep')
	if text then root:node(text) end
	-- the game shows the time that is left on a running effect; here it is the duration of the effect
	local ms = tonumber(d.dur) or 0
	if ms > 0 then
		local sec = string.format('%.1f', ms / 1000):gsub('%.0$', '')
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-buff-time'):wikitext('Duration: ' .. sec .. 'sec')
	end
	return tostring(root)
end

return p
